query: SELECT count(*) AS "total!",count(*) FILTER(WHERE s.origin=t.origin) AS "origin!",count(*) FILTER(WHERE v.channel_uri=$2 AND e.state='active') AS "channel!" FROM discovery_entries e JOIN discovery_sources s ON s.id=e.source_id LEFT JOIN discovery_video_details v ON v.entry_id=e.id CROSS JOIN discovery_sources t WHERE t.id=$1 AND e.kind='video'
